headline: The lost-wallet flow is derivable, but the gold records RUSH shipping and the PREMIUM card design, which the customer specifies only if asked and only as "the best option that's free".

issues.summary: order_debit_card_5739 requires delivery_option and card_design. For ELITE tier, STANDARD/EXPEDITED/RUSH and CLASSIC/PREMIUM/CUSTOM are all $0, and the customer gives a preference only if asked ("whatever the best option is that's free"). RUSH is the clear "best free" shipping, but "best free" design is PREMIUM or CUSTOM; an agent that does not ask has no documented default.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029: ELITE "Complimentary shipping on all replacements (delivery_fee: $0 for STANDARD, EXPEDITED, and RUSH)"; "PREMIUM design (metallic silver): design_fee $0 (complimentary)"; "CUSTOM design (uploaded image): design_fee $0 (complimentary)"
user_scenario step 8: "ONLY IF agent asks about shipping speed or card design options: I'd like whatever the best option is that's free with my account."
replay: STANDARD -> "table 'debit_card_orders' differs"; CLASSIC -> debit_card_orders and debit_cards differ
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that picks defaults (STANDARD/CLASSIC) without asking fails; one that asks will very likely reach RUSH/PREMIUM, since CUSTOM needs an uploaded image.
issues.suggested_fix: Have the customer state the shipping and design preference up front, or make doc_029 name a default for ELITE replacements.

solution_check: Derived: verify; look up accounts and both cards; freeze both (customer unsure, doc_026); check credit cards and replace the Silver Rewards card (doc_030; standard shipping because expedited costs $10 for mid-tier and the customer wants free); check transactions for pending items (doc_025 requirement 4; none pending); unfreeze (close_debit_card_4721 accepts only ACTIVE or PENDING, so a frozen card must be unfrozen; replay shows a failed close-while-frozen attempt leaves the same state); close both as lost; order only the Bluest replacement (ELITE, no wait; Light Green ENTRY has a 48-hour wait); activate with 8292 (issue_reason lost). Matches the gold.
prior_note: Prior review rated the task clean; the shipping/design choice is a new minor finding (v1.0.1 added the reads the prior flagged as missing).
notes: Grading-model facts confirmed against the snapshot: gold replay + hash compare (evaluator_env.py); read logging only for gold-named discoverable reads (_derive_read_log_allowlist, call_discoverable_agent_tool); parse_int=float on discoverable args; apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float. Verified scorer (working-repo _verified_db_match) compares agent_discoverable_tools by tool-name set only and strips accounts.closure_reason; all other tables exact. Replays used the grep_only retrieval variant (no embeddings needed) with the gold-derived allowlist. Required reads: get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847, get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823, get_bank_account_transactions_9173 (replay: skipping the transactions read fails). get_credit_card_accounts_by_user is a base read and is not logged. Ordering the Bluest card before closing the frozen card would succeed with issue_reason first_card and break activation; doc_025 places ordering after closure. doc_025 requirement 4 (no pending transactions) and its lost-card step ("any pending transactions will still be processed") pull in different directions; no rows are pending here, so it does not matter. Persona says 22, DOB gives 23 (cosmetic).
